response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.90. The proposal is recorded and awaits a human decision.

**What drove it:**
1. T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It re-quoted paired 381-lot bids and asks every 1–10 seconds. Cancel symmetry is 0.957, and no single order was above 0.149 times depth.
2. The SELL quotes were filled for 2,113 in total, all before any opposite-side trade. There was no BUY execution at all, so feature (b), a benefit from an opposite-side execution, is absent. The resting quotes were also trading, so feature (a), an order not meant to execute, is absent.
3. No public events, no risk events and no layering. Market-wide cancels in the second before the first cancel were 0, and repetitions in session were 0. The two earlier closures on this trader matched what I found, but I did not rely on them.

**What would change my mind:** a single order of 3x depth or more, cancels on one side only, or a BUY execution at a price the resting SELL side had moved before the cancel. None of these appear in this window.
